title: Go For It, Nakamura!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nakamura is a shy, clumsy high school boy who has fallen in love at first sight with his classmate Hirose, though they have never spoken. Each episodic chapter follows his awkward, comic attempts to get close to Hirose without bungling it. It is a single-volume comedy that parodies school romance tropes.
life_message: Small, brave steps toward someone you care about are worth the embarrassment.

content.note: A boy's innocent crush on another boy; MangaDex rates safe; no sexual content noted.
Shyness and fear of rejection played for comedy (AniList Unrequited Love).
Mild comic mishaps; light crossdressing gag (AniList tag, low rank).
Parody of manga tropes (AniList Parody, Meta).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Peers interact as equals; little rank.

delivery.note: Courage is carried by Nakamura's comic attempts rather than by stated lessons.
